title: Compass Upgrade
description: Compass show coordinates, sight of see,  X+ X- Z+ Z- in actionbar (More in description)
body:
**It works while you handlling a compass in main or off hands in actionbar** ![showcase (full)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jnnhQsei/images/03f7c393f2763d619160a63dc3de807acf3d0889.png) # You will see: ![showcase (ZOOMED)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jnnhQsei/images/49846d7123e70460f45f2b4e85f4ffbd5ad6c794.png) 1. Coordinates 2. Sight of see 3. (X+ X- Z+ Z-) # How to use? 1. Craft a compass 2. Take a compass (Main or Off hand) 3. And instead name of item you will see new mechanic # Feature map [✅] - Show coordinates, sight of see, (X+ X- Z+ Z-)
[✅] - Make colorfull (Like BetterF3) - More than other plugins (They shows only coordinates)
